title: Introducing Cart Legends - v0.0.9.1 Free Playtest
author: ProudAd3678
selftext:
**We are making a multiplayer cart builder in Godot and could use some people to break it**

Hey! We are working on Cart Legends a game where you build a cart piece by piece, stick thrusters, pistons and hammers wherever you think they belong, then take it racing with friends and find out whether that was a good idea.

There's a working damage system, 10 race circuits and some battle arenas we are still working on. It's early, nothing is properly balanced yet, and there's no builder tutorial, so expect some trial and error in the workshop.

We'd love to see what people build and hear what feels fun, confusing or just annoying. That feedback will help us decide what to work on next.

**The game is designed using GPT 5.5 following 5.6 and then GPT 6, in vibe-coding workflows, guided by a senior developer.**

The Steam playtest is free to join!

comments.author: dont-pull-a-druckman
comments.body:
Ah yes, the multiplayer game made in "go dough". 

Just kill me please.

replies.author: ProudAd3678
replies.body: You will have to explain what bothers you about our game.

replies.author: ehhhhokbud
replies.body: They’re talking about the bad AI voiceover and it’s pronunciation of “godot”

replies.author: ProudAd3678
replies.body: Ah, imagine me caring about that. Jesus :)) Thank you for explaining this!

replies.author: ehhhhokbud
replies.body: Yeah I hear you. Was just informing you more specifically what their complaint is about. The English pronunciation is often “guh-do”. Regardless of semantics, I wasn’t the one upset about it. With all this said, you do seem genuinely insufferable. Best of luck to you.

replies.author: ProudAd3678
replies.body:
Godot is pronounced **“go-dough”** because it’s named after Samuel Beckett’s play *Waiting for Godot*, originally written in French. In French, the final **“t” is silent**, and English pronunciations generally keep that silent ending—so the last syllable sounds like **“dough.”**

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gYBSrqT\_1tQ**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gYBSrqT_1tQ)

**Educate yourself!**

comments.author: pikuray
comments.body: Hey this looks like a nice game for ai I'm trying to make my own game could you say how much it cost in tokens approx? Thanks

replies.author: ProudAd3678
replies.body: Hey! A normal pro subscription will fit as long as you take on the planning, supervise it constantly and do some of the work yourself (3D for example). It also depends on how fast you want to achieve it. I personally work myself on the game when I am out of usage. There is always something to do.

replies.author: ProudAd3678
replies.body: To make it clear, this is FAR from a 1 month subscription or a single prompt project. This is not one of those GPT-6 one shotted this, GPT-6 struggles with this :)

replies.author: pikuray
replies.body: Fascinating, thank you. Yes this seems a lot more complex than the oneshot stuff that gets posted here. It reminds me of RoboCraft which i used to play a lot.
